kast 0.27.0 (semantic runtime sha256:9f0df5b37b60354f0aefe542cf02705889cb05f575b5d3837cbe06ba9b8f3212) 

Usage: 
    kast [<options>] <command> [<args>]... 
    Inspect and change one exact Kotlin workspace through typed semantic operations. 
    Options: 
        --version Show product and semantic runtime versions 
        --schema Print the installed machine-readable schema 
        -h, --help Show this message and exit Commands: workspace Inspect the exact canonical workspace.
        symbol
            Discover, resolve, and describe Kotlin symbols.
        relation 
            Read one-hop semantic relations.
        traversal 
            Traverse bounded semantic relation graphs. 
        diagnostic
            Read bounded compiler diagnostics.
        change 
            Plan, apply, verify, and recover typed changes.
        start
            Start or reuse the exact-root runtime. 
        stop
            Stop the exact-root runtime and retire markers.
        status 
            Read exact-root runtime status. 
        clean 
            Remove stopped runtime markers and state.
        reindex 
            Stop, clean, and rebuild exact-root semantic state.
    Semantic results are one JSON document on stdout. Diagnostics are one JSON document on stderr.
